# AutoApply CV

## What this site is
AutoApply CV is an AI-assisted job search automation platform focused on LinkedIn Easy Apply workflows, reusable screening answers, and application tracking.

## Key pages
- Product: /product
- Features: /features
- How it works: /how-it-works
- Pricing: /pricing
- FAQ: /faq
- Blog: /blog
- Contact: /contact

## Content types
- Marketing pages describing product features and pricing
- Help/troubleshooting content for extension + dashboard sync
- Blog articles about job search automation and best practices
